settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your company, its branches and modules, who can join, and how you’re notified.
settings.empty.title: Nothing to set up here
settings.empty.body: Your role has no settings to change in this company.
settings.panel.roles.hint: Who may see and do what
settings.panel.positions.hint: The jobs people pick when they join
settings.panel.attendance.description: How people check in, when they are reminded and what needs your approval.
settings.panel.reminders.defaults.descri: The default reminder policy: every routine and task without its own policy follows it.
settings.panel.projects.description: What every new board starts with, the weekly update reminder and when a project counts as at risk.
settings.panel.sales.hint: How sales are recorded, cash checks, alerts
settings.panel.sales.description: How cashiers record sales and close shifts, and when managers hear about it.
settings.panel.registers.hint: Each branch’s tills and what they hold
settings.panel.registers.description: Each branch’s tills: where cashiers open their shifts, and what each one holds now.
settings.panel.payment-methods.descripti: How customers can pay, in the order cashiers see them in Kassa.
settings.panel.finance.description: Expense and income categories, exchange rates, the closed period and money thresholds.
settings.panel.agenda.description: Company events: the reminder they start with and invitations in Telegram.
settings.panel.knowledge.description: Telegram news when a page is published, and the reminder for pages people must confirm.
settings.readOnly.title: View only
settings.readOnly.body: Only someone allowed to change company settings can edit these.
settings.company.description: How your company looks to staff and how its days are organised.
settings.company.identityHint: Shown in the switcher, on invites and on printed documents.
settings.company.logoHint: A square picture works best. PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB.
settings.company.logoTooBig: That picture is over 10 MB. Choose a smaller one.
settings.company.name: Company name
settings.company.timezoneHint: Reports, deadlines and shifts follow this clock.
settings.company.languageHint: For group posts and new staff. Each person can pick their own.
settings.company.currencyHint: Reports and the ledger add up in this currency.
settings.company.currencyLocked: Locked: money is already booked in it.
settings.company.weekHint: Used for people without planned shifts, and for the daily group reports.
settings.company.workdaysHint: Routines give their tasks on these days.
settings.company.workdaysRequired: Pick at least one working day.
settings.company.sameTimes: The two reports need different times.
settings.company.digestHint: At the morning report time, everyone gets their tasks for the day from the bot.
settings.company.peopleHint: What owners and colleagues can see.
settings.company.personalTasksHint: Tasks employees make for themselves show to owners. Employees are told in the app. They never count in KPIs.
settings.company.phonesHint: The team directory in the app shows each colleague’s number.
settings.company.cooldown: Wait before asking to join again
settings.company.cooldownHint: How long someone you rejected waits before they can ask again.
settings.company.audited: Every change is saved in the audit log.
settings.modules.description: Switch on only what your business uses. A module switched off keeps its data, hidden until it comes back.
settings.modules.offBody: It disappears from the sidebar for everyone. Nothing is deleted: switch it back on any time and everything is where you left it.
settings.modules.onHint: Its defaults are ready. Find it in the sidebar.
settings.module.finance.title: Finance
settings.module.finance.body: Cash desks, bank and cards, income and expenses, debts and profit.
settings.module.sales.title: Sales and cash
settings.module.sales.body: Tills per branch, cashier shifts with a blind cash count, Z‑report photos, sales analytics.
settings.module.stock.title: Stock
settings.module.stock.body: Products, stock per branch, goods receipts and stock counts.
settings.module.attendance.title: Attendance
settings.module.attendance.body: Schedules and the roster, check-in with location, lateness and timesheets.
settings.module.hr.title: HR
settings.module.hr.body: Profiles, documents with expiry, contracts, policies, hiring and discipline.
settings.module.payroll.title: Payroll
settings.module.payroll.body: Pay setups, bonuses and fines, advances, monthly runs and payslips.
settings.module.ai.title: AI assistant
settings.module.ai.body: Ask about your business in plain words, read receipts, draft tasks and announcements.
settings.module.recognition.title: Recognition
settings.module.recognition.body: Kudos between colleagues and a monthly leaderboard.
settings.branches.description: Every pharmacy, warehouse or office. Staff check in inside a branch’s circle, and new tasks belong to the branch people work in.
settings.branches.emptyBody: Add your first branch with its address and check-in circle.
settings.branch.missingBody: The link may be old, or the branch is outside the branches you can see.
settings.branch.newHint: Where it is, when it’s open, who runs it.
settings.branch.name: Name
settings.branch.codeInvalid: Latin letters and digits only, like CHL.
settings.branch.placeHint: Click the map or drag the pin. Staff check in inside the circle.
settings.branch.allDayHint: No opening or closing time, so no “not opened” alerts.
settings.branch.cashLimitHint: More cash than this after closing raises an alert.
settings.branch.closeBody: It leaves pickers and gets no new work. Its history, money and people’s records stay. You can reopen it any time.
settings.map.label: Map of the branch
settings.map.clickToPlace: Click the map to place the branch
settings.invite.description: Staff join from Telegram. The main link asks for your approval; team links add many people at once.
settings.invite.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the link and copy it.
settings.invite.renewBody: The current link and every printed poster stop working at once. People already in the company are not affected.
settings.invite.renewed: New link ready. Print a fresh poster.
settings.invite.noBotBody: Invite links need the employee bot’s username on the server. Ask whoever runs it to set it up.
settings.invite.scanBody: Point the phone camera at the code, or send the link in a chat.
settings.invite.how1: They open the link: the bot asks for their name, phone and position.
settings.invite.how2: You get a join request here and in the bot.
settings.invite.how3: Approve with a role and a branch. Their tasks start the next morning.
settings.invite.safety: Nobody joins through this link without your approval. If it leaks, make a new one. Team links let people in straight away: give each one a place limit and an end date.
settings.invite.poster.dialogTitle: A poster to hang at work
settings.invite.poster.hint: A4, in your company’s language and Russian.
settings.invite.poster.title: Join our team
settings.invite.poster.step1: Scan the QR code with your phone camera
settings.invite.poster.step3: Send your name and position. Your manager approves you
settings.invite.poster.step3Auto: Send your name and position. You’re on the team at once
settings.teamLinks.title: Team links
settings.teamLinks.why: Add many people at once: everyone who opens the link joins straight away with the branch and role you choose.
settings.teamLinks.emptyTitle: Add a whole team in one go
settings.teamLinks.emptyBody: Show the QR code at a staff meeting or post the link in a chat. Everyone who opens it joins straight away with the branch and role you choose, until the places run out or the link ends.
settings.teamLinks.noneLive: No link is working right now. Make a new one, or edit an ended one to give it a new end date.
settings.teamLinks.viewOnlyHint: It gives a branch or role you can’t give, so you can’t change it.
settings.teamLinks.deleteBody: The link and its QR code stop working at once. People who joined through it stay on the team.
settings.teamLinks.toast.stopped: Link stopped: nobody new can join through it
settings.teamLinks.toast.resumedExpired: Resumed, but its end date has passed. Edit it to set a new one.
settings.teamLinks.toast.resumedFull: Resumed, but every place is taken. Edit it to add places.
settings.teamLinks.toast.deleted: Link deleted. People who joined stay.
settings.teamLinks.field.name: Name
settings.teamLinks.field.nameHint: For you: where or when you’ll show it.
settings.teamLinks.field.autoOn: Everyone who opens the link is on the team at once, with the branch and role below.
settings.teamLinks.field.autoOff: They appear in Join requests and you approve them, all at once if you like.
settings.teamLinks.field.branchRequired: Pick the branch they’ll work at
settings.teamLinks.field.roleHint: What they may see and do
settings.teamLinks.field.positionHint: Chosen for them in the app; they can change it.
settings.teamLinks.field.placesHint: When the places run out, the link stops adding people.
settings.teamLinks.field.wideOpen: Anyone who gets this link can join until you stop it. A place limit or an end date keeps it safe.
settings.teamLinks.error.past: Pick a time in the future
settings.teamLinks.error.tooFar: At most a year from now
settings.teamLinks.live.scan: Point your phone camera at the code
settings.teamLinks.live.left: {n} places left | {n} place left | {n} places left
settings.teamLinks.live.nobody: No one joined through this link
settings.teamLinks.live.closedHint.full: Edit the link to add places.
settings.teamLinks.live.closedHint.expir: Edit the link to give it a new end date.
settings.teamLinks.live.closedHint.stopp: Resume it to let people in again.
settings.notifications.description: For each kind of alert, choose whether it shows in the dashboard and whether Telegram sends it.
settings.notifications.inQueue: Decisions always show in Needs you.
settings.notifications.emptyBody: Modules add their alerts here as you switch them on.
settings.notifications.footer: Critical alerts also pop up on screen and show their count in the browser tab.
settings.sessions.description: Browsers signed in to the dashboard as you. Sign out any you don’t recognise.
settings.sessions.telegramNote: You’re in the dashboard through Telegram, which needs no session. Your browser sessions are listed below.
settings.sessions.emptyBody: When you sign in on a computer, it shows here.
settings.sessions.signOutBody: That browser loses access within 15 minutes and must sign in with Telegram again.
settings.sessions.othersBody: {n} other devices will be signed out. This browser stays signed in. | {n} other device will be signed out. This browser stays signed in. | {n} other devices will be signed out. This browser stays signed in.
settings.sessions.othersDone: Signed out {n} devices | Signed out {n} device | Signed out {n} devices
settings.sessions.everywhereBody: Every browser, this one included, is signed out and every sign-in token stops working. Use it if a device was lost.
settings.sessions.footer: Signing in always goes through Telegram with number matching. The bot tells you about every new sign-in.
